name: BlockFrame
description: Maximalist neobrutalist deck. Five-pastel palette (pink, cyan, green, yellow, cream) + pure black + warm off-white. Space Grotesk display. Inter body. Chunky 3px black borders. Hard 8px offset shadows. Tilted decorative elements. Black close-frame with yellow shadow.
descriptionZh: 极繁新粗野主义演示系统。五彩粉彩调色板（粉、青、绿、黄、奶油色）+ 纯黑 + 暖白。Space Grotesk 展示字体。Inter 正文。粗 3px 黑色边框。8px 硬偏移阴影。倾斜装饰元素。黑色结束框架 + 黄色阴影。
avoidFor: 安静 / 机构规范性内容
